context: Ferg Drogher is a Sharran informer and Shadowheart’s cult contact — someone the Shar network has been expecting to hear from when she completes her mission. He doubles as a lookout, fence and money launderer, so his dealings involve wagers, guarded gossip, and odd goods for trade. His tone toward Shadowheart depends on her alignment: if she remains on the Shar Path he will hint there’s a chance for her to seize power, but if she has rejected Shar he greets her with suspicion and open disgust. Off-screen, Shadowheart’s current arc (in some branches) has her renouncing Shar and traveling to Baldur’s Gate to rescue her captive parents, which explains the tense, accusatory exchanges and the player’s opportunity to intervene.
